marks.gloss_en: Achai beribbi asked: one saw a pig trailing after a ewe -- what is [the law]?
what he asks is: for the firstborn, according to the Rabbis; for eating, according to RSBG
one who slaughters a firstborn makes a place with a cleaver on this side and that, and plucks out the hair
אי אמר הלכה כרבי יוסי בן המשולם, איפשוט לכו -- once Rav Chananel confirms Rav's ruling, Rav Huna: opposite it on a Festival is permitted
opposite it [the parallel case, a non-sacred animal slaughtered] on a Festival -- [plucking the hair] is permitted
Rav: the halakha follows R' Yosei ben HaMeshullam
horn 2: or perhaps in general RYbHM holds plucking IS shearing
